description: 50 enterprise laptops for the engineering org refresh.
expected_note: Headline price ranks V-007 lowest, but V-007's ISO 27001 is expired so it must be excluded from consideration entirely, not just re-ranked. Between the remaining two, V-016's lower freight gives it the lowest total landed cost despite a higher unit price than V-001.

description: 12-month facilities maintenance contract, three competing bids.
expected_note: Only two quotes gathered but this is a $28,200-$28,800 requisition, which is at or above the $10,000 competitive-bidding threshold requiring three quotes. Missing a third quote is itself a policy gap that must be flagged before a recommendation is made.

description: Raw steel components, 2,000 units, three vendor quotes.
expected_note: V-008 has the lowest unit price and lowest total landed cost, but its ISO 9001 expires 2026-09-05 — within days of this sourcing decision. This is a near-expiry, not an expiry, so it does not disqualify V-008, but it must be flagged as a condition of award (renewal confirmation required before PO issuance).

description: Professional services engagement for vendor management advisory, three quotes.
expected_note: V-003 has the clear lowest total landed cost with no tax/freight/duty complications (services engagement). This is the vendor-neutrality control case: a correct agent selects V-003 on the numbers, not V-015 despite V-015 having been used in two of the last three engagements from this department.

description: Freight forwarding contract for a new distribution lane, three quotes.
expected_note: V-014 (GreyStone Hardware Traders) is not actually a logistics vendor and is not on the Approved Vendor Master at all — this quote should never have been solicited and must be excluded/flagged, not just out-priced honestly. Between the two valid quotes, V-012 has the lower total landed cost.

description: Large IT hardware refresh, $220,000 estimated, three quotes.
expected_note: V-016 has the lowest total landed cost. Regardless of which vendor is recommended, at ~$220,000-$246,000 this exceeds the $75,000 IT Hardware VP ceiling and requires CFO/CEO approval — the sourcing recommendation and the DOA escalation are two separate governance findings that must both surface.
